title: Canonical Hybrid Retrieval
root_cause: The advertised hybrid capability delegates to a lexical/token-cosine script while accepting non-lexical signal fields that cannot affect scoring.
source_requirement: Delegate to the strongest existing retrieval owner and expose independent lexical, dense/vector, metadata, structured, graph, and freshness/trust signals.
implementation_steps: Inventory current retrieval owners and select the strongest canonical implementation.
Adapt the advertised skill to that owner.
Produce per-signal score components and source revisions.
Keep deterministic fallback when optional signals are unavailable.
negative_cases: Missing signal silently reported as present.
affected_tests: Capability routing and memory retrieval observability tests.
evidence_required: Ablation receipt proving each declared signal independently affects or is explicitly unavailable.
rollback: Restore the prior skill adapter; do not remove the selected canonical retrieval owner.
acceptance_criteria: No parallel retrieval engine is created.
Receipts truthfully expose all independent signals and revisions.
